content: कर्मन् {%m.%} Viśvakarmā; शकस्य नु सभा दिव्या भास्वरा कर्मनिर्मिता <ls>Mb. 2. 7. 1</ls>. --{%n.%} [कृ-मनिन् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 144</ls>] .²1 Action, work, deed. .²2 Execution, performance; प्रीतोऽस्मि सोऽहं यद् भुक्तं वनं तैः कृतकर्मभिः <ls>Rām. 5. 63. 30</ls>. .²3 Business, office, duty; संप्रति विषवैद्यानां कर्म <ls>M. 4</ls>. .²4 A religious rite (it may be either नित्य, नैमित्तिक or काम्य). .²5 A specific action, moral duty. .²6 .³({%a%}) Performance of religious rites as opposed to speculative religion or knowledge of Brahman (<ab>opp.</ab> ज्ञान); अपरो दहने स्वकर्मणां ववृते <ls>R. 8. 20</ls>. .³({%b%}) Labour, work. .²7 Product, result. .²8 A natural or active property (as support of the earth). .²9 Fate, the certain consequence of acts done in a former life; कर्मायत्तं फलं पुंसां बुद्धिः कर्मानुसारिणी <ls>Bh. 2. 89</ls>, <ls n="Bh. 2.">94</ls>. .²10 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The object of of an action; कर्तुरीप्सिततमं कर्म <ls>P. I. 4. 49</ls>. .²11 (In <ab>Vaiś. Phil.</ab>) Motion considered as one of the seven categories of things; thus defined:-- एकद्रव्यमगुणं संयोगविभागेष्वनपेक्षकारणं कर्म <ls>Vaiś. Up. 1. 5. 21</ls>. .²13 Organ of action; कर्माणि कर्मभिः कुर्वन् <ls>Bhāg. 11. 3. 6</ls>. .²14 (In <ab>Astr.</ab>) The tenth lunar mansion. .²15 Practice, training; सर्वेषां कर्मणा वीर्यं जवस्तेजश्च वर्धते <ls>Kau. A. 2. 2</ls>.
